decisions.reason: As a multi-model organic flagship that is central to the firm's announced organic direction and visible on the website in both years, dropping it would write off a visible commitment and expose the strategy as a mistake.
The Salamissimo line has several models and was relaunched with new variants in 2024, signalling continued investment, though its shift from its own page to a mere mention adds some risk.
A newly launched organic sausage, publicly announced as a new member of the organic team, fits the announced organic direction, and any weak early results can still be blamed on its recent launch.
A multi-variant organic chicken line launched in 2024 with its own page and explicit launch announcements represents visible commitment to the organic strategy, and it is too early to judge it.

Although it is a single item close to the existing salami offer with lower investment, it is new, has its own page, and supports the organic expansion, so its results can still be attributed to temporary causes.
